scenario: Fogar Desktop app (FogarDesktop) connected to an unpaired agent over IPC, hands-off
machine: Mac14,15 (MacBook Air 15-inch, Apple M2), macOS 26.5.1 (25F80), AC power, Low Power Mode off
method: perf/measure.sh with no warm-up (both processes up > 90 min), 600 s windows; app = apps/macos/build/Fogar Desktop.app; agent = release build of e0d66a2 (same source tree as main 9013fea), signed com.fogar.agent / Q6UYYP85B7
notes: NOT a controlled open/closed comparison: the window ("Emparejar") was open at the start of run 1 and closed at its end; closed at the start of run 2 and open again at its end. Someone used the app during the runs. The app cost the same in both: ~0.02 % CPU, 0.38 wakeups/s.
The 12 Hz FondoVivo timer cannot have run for long in either window (it alone would be >= 12 wakeups/s); it only ticks while animated.
App phys_footprint 43 MB idle, lifetime peak 91 MB. The 50 MB budget is the daemon's; no app budget is declared.
Machine load average 15 -> 4 over these runs (other sessions), lower than in s1-unpaired.json.
